BC_description: The `onFID()` function has been removed in v5.0.0 after being previously deprecated. This function was part of the web-vitals library and was used to measure First Input Delay. Its removal means any direct calls to `onFID()` will now result in a runtime error. Developers are advised to migrate to alternative Web Vitals metrics such as `onINP()` or `onTTFB()` depending on their specific use case.
Adaptation_method:
Remove all calls to `onFID()`. Developers should use `onINP(callback)` as the recommended replacement for measuring input responsiveness, as INP (Interaction to Next Paint) is the new Core Web Vital intended to replace FID. For use cases requiring early loading performance measurement, consider `onTTFB(callback)`. Example:
Before: onFID(sendMetricToAnalytics)
After: onINP(sendMetricToAnalytics)
